# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite rendering and async readback** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 introduces Graphite GPU rendering and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia m152** — Updates the bundled renderer to m152 and VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0, retaining the allocator fallback used by SkiaSharp callers. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651))
- **Skia m152 servicing** — Includes a same-milestone native refresh without changing the managed API or tracked dependency versions. ([#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU rendering** — Adds explicit record, snap, insert, and submit APIs for Graphite with Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn contexts, including browser WebGPU. Existing Ganesh APIs remain unchanged; Graphite pixel readback uses the asynchronous API. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral asynchronous readback** — SKImage and SKSurface.RequestReadPixels deliver callback-scoped RGBA results with copy-out helpers. Raster callbacks run synchronously; Ganesh work must be submitted and drained with GRContext.CheckAsyncWorkCompletion. Results become invalid after the callback returns. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Platform

- **Silk.NET Vulkan integration** — Ships SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET with typed backend-context helpers, including Android-capable Vulkan loading. GRVkExtensions can be constructed publicly; the SharpVk integration remains available. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))
- **Explicit fonts on Nano Server** — The FreeType-backed Nano Server native build can render typefaces loaded from files, streams, or data. It still has no system font discovery, so applications must supply fonts explicitly. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Native debugging symbols** — Produces separate Apple native symbol packages with complete dSYM bundles and gives Android libraries deterministic split-debug identities. Apple customer packages remain free of dSYM payloads. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Keep borrowed native memory alive** — Region iterators retain their source region, and pixmap subsets and With* results retain the ultimate pixel owner, preventing premature finalization while those views are in use. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Prompt native resource release** — Frees raster pixel allocations when SKImage.Create fails, disposes the previous uniform buffer on Reset, and releases consumed non-memory-backed stream assets when their HarfBuzz blob is released. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))
- **Less copying and allocation** — SKData.SaveTo avoids an intermediate copy on span-capable targets, Font.Shape reuses caller feature arrays, and tag formatting avoids char boxing. Text encoding, uniform lookup construction, and native-wrapper registration also avoid redundant work. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Bug Fixes

- **Cached-data teardown safety** — Releases the native cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owner, avoiding an unlock through freed memory. ([#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))
- **Readback and font stability** — Includes m151 native font-rendering and Ganesh fixes, including failure handling that prevents readbacks from returning stale texture data. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Avoids copying caller-owned feature arrays during shaping and removes char boxing from tag formatting. Adds separate Apple native symbol packages and deterministic Android debug identities; native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1.

## Release Candidate 1 (August 26, 2026)

Restored production of the Silk.NET Vulkan package and added separate Apple native symbol packages. Reduced shaping and tag-formatting allocation and fixed uniform-buffer and stream-asset cleanup.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.152.0-preview.1.1...v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Introduced Graphite rendering, asynchronous pixel readback, Silk.NET Vulkan helpers, and explicit font loading on Nano Server. Also fixed region/pixmap owner lifetimes and raster-image failure cleanup.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.5...v4.152.0-preview.1.1)
